mechanism: Immutable-baseline cumulative replay guard with a frozen 1.5% hard limit, evaluated at the optimizer boundary. The guard bound before enough quantity learning occurred: eight consecutive rejections triggered the fallback after 66 committed updates.
summary: Q2.4 seed 2 committed 66 candidates under the frozen 1.5% cumulative replay authority. Attempts 67-74 each exceeded the ceiling and rolled back, ending the run via the eight-rejection fallback before any public checkpoint or promotion evaluation.
lineage_note: Q2.4 validates the cumulative guard as a safety boundary but rejects it as a complete learning policy. A follow-up must change candidate direction, objective, or optimization geometry.
